name: popups-thank-you-v1
title: Thank-you Popup v1
description: Thank-you V1: the confirmation as a modal popup — a check mark in a soft circle, a short title, one line of body and a full-width Close button. Exports the panel on its own too, so the Sign-up Popup can crossfade to it in place. Focus lands on the title, so screen readers hear the confirmation.
